python3 -c "
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('src/ir/runtime_fn.rs')
t = p.read_text()
old = '''            RuntimeFnId::Abs
                | RuntimeFnId::Gettype
                | RuntimeFnId::Trim
        )'''
new = '''            RuntimeFnId::Abs
                | RuntimeFnId::Gettype
                | RuntimeFnId::Trim
                | RuntimeFnId::Fclose
                | RuntimeFnId::Feof
                | RuntimeFnId::Fgets
                | RuntimeFnId::Ftell
        )'''
assert t.count(old) == 1
t = t.replace(old, new, 1)
old2 = '''            RuntimeFnId::Gettype => true,
            RuntimeFnId::Trim => source.is_none_or(|ty| matches!(ty, PhpType::Str)),'''
new2 = '''            RuntimeFnId::Gettype => true,
            RuntimeFnId::Trim => source.is_none_or(|ty| matches!(ty, PhpType::Str)),
            RuntimeFnId::Fclose
            | RuntimeFnId::Feof
            | RuntimeFnId::Fgets
            | RuntimeFnId::Ftell => true,'''
assert t.count(old2) == 1
t = t.replace(old2, new2, 1)
p.write_text(t)
print('experiment: four resource builtins made dynamically callable')
